candidate: r4 local remediation candidate, not deployed or qualified

findings.title: Verifier failures are bounded by r3's own 120-second deadline
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Installed SDK @google/genai code confirms X-Server-Timeout derives from httpOptions.timeout. No live A/B or causal attribution performed; timeout unchanged.

findings.title: The single AbortError is a harness artifact
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: New r4-only harness paces before SDK entry. Original r3 harness and failure receipts remain unchanged.

findings.title: Unresolved changes are re-analysed every cycle; observe mode duplicates ledger claims
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Persistent assessment key binds implementation, mode, source scope, baseline, contract, extraction profile, content, transport/final URL and configured models. Repeated captures retain original review/claims. Refresh invalidates memo. New content invalidation tested.

findings.title: Deterministic failures are retried and never reach a reviewer
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Incomplete/invalid JSON and budget output become review holds instead of repeated generation; terminal failures now retain review rows. Some pre-checkpoint failures still lack a reusable content decision; real size distribution remains unmeasured.

findings.title: Provider errors are erased from durable state; engine calls are outside AI telemetry
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Durable model_http_429/503/504 and deadline codes with bounded available Retry-After. No raw provider text persisted. Full per-model invocation/usage telemetry remains open.

findings.title: No quota- or rate-aware scheduling; token gate exceeds the observed free per-minute limit
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: 429 holds without immediate repeat attempts; full system instruction counted; input cap reduced to 200000 tokens. No general per-model scheduler/RPM/TPM/RPD accounting or current entitlement proof.

findings.title: High-impact rule misses four of the product's six taxonomy categories and common phrasings
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Conservative source-word rules cover previously missed training, sale/consent, retention, sharing, licensing, common law/termination phrases. Eleven injected examples pass independently of score. No human-approved taxonomy or general recall claim.

findings.title: Model impact score is non-discriminating and crossed the review threshold for the same fact
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Expanded deterministic routing limits dependence on the score. Numeric score calibration and public risk semantics remain open.

findings.title: Date-role guard passes a false effective-date claim
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Date-role negatives in E6 with verdicts.

findings.title: Language is verified from publisher metadata, not content
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: E4 corpus including a mislabelled page.

findings.title: Hosted preview cannot run an unattended 500/day with r3
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Protocol section 4 preconditions met on the intended host.

findings.title: Live worker diagnostic disabled the hosted guards
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: E7 receipts with worker leadership status.

findings.title: Wave stop rule ignored repeated 5xx and timeouts
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: New harness stops after two consecutive generation transport failures; old wave unchanged.

findings.title: Receipts omit every request header
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: New harness retains only allowlisted non-secret deadline/client/content-type request headers. No new live receipts.

findings.title: Backup is non-transactional, whole-database in memory, verification-only and unbound to the candidate
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Export reads all tables within Serializable transaction, binds implementation/provider/applied migrations when ledger exists, and labels missing migration ledger null. Isolated DB and mock transaction tests passed. Streaming, restore drill and resource ceilings remain open.

findings.title: No retention for artifacts, tasks, attempts or reviews; growth unmeasured
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Daily database size series over Phase A.

findings.title: Readiness report omits engine configuration; PostgreSQL integrity fields are constants
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Separate engine configuration presence displayed in admin readiness. PostgreSQL quick-check and FK fields explicitly not measured/null, not fabricated passed values. No operational readiness claim.

findings.title: Ledger evidence cannot be re-verified from ledger rows alone
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: E8 check that every restored span equals a slice of a restored document.

findings.title: Contracts and approvals are single-administrator, role-labelled attestations
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Schema and route changes with tests on a new candidate.

findings.title: Canonical-graph projection labels auto-published changes as published and public-unpublished ones as reviewed
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Unpublished public-evidence projections stay draft, not human-reviewed based only on publication flags. Historical published projections retain published status.

findings.title: Hosted implementation identity is build-asserted
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Implementation inventory now also hashes migration SQL, both CLI-free initializers, readiness and backup closure. Runtime identity remains build-asserted when files absent; archive verification still required.

findings.title: A hold for high-impact review alone marks the check successful and the policy Available
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: High-impact review hold records Needs Review without advancing lastSuccessfulCheckDate. Observe-mode public fields remain unchanged.

findings.title: Transport-variant drift may confirm as a change
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Two-capture confirmation now binds transport and final URL. Comparison against baseline transport and rendered/direct truth qualification remain open.

findings.title: Token-budget check excludes the system instruction and doubles HTTP requests
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: SDK token count includes system instruction. CountTokens remains a separate HTTP request.

findings.title: Model identity is alias-level
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Canary receipts dated per trial day.

findings.title: Retained reviewer transcripts are lossy accessibility-tree scrapes
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Original full Fable files retained byte-for-byte rather than only accessibility excerpts. Earlier reviewer transcripts remain lossy historical evidence.

findings.title: Public summary and risk come from unverified analyst fields
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Owner decision and test.

findings.title: Verifier-side prompt injection untested; model text flows to public page and e-mail
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: E6 injection subset with labels.

findings.title: 15-second transaction ceiling unmeasured for large documents
findings.evidenceOrRemainingWork: Timing series.
